question.text: In amplitude modulation, the sinusoidal carrier frequency used is denoted by <math><msub><mrow><mi>ω</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>c</mi></mrow></msub></math> and the signal frequency is denoted by <math><msub><mrow><mi>ω</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>m</mi></mrow></msub></math> . ∵ Δωm≪ωc
